snippet.title: Rush 'N Attack: Ex-Patriot - PS3 (Konami 2011)
snippet.description:
Rush 'N Attack: Ex-Patriot PS3 is the remake of the classic Rush 'N Attack arcade video game. You can infiltrate my website The Dot Eaters and extract the history of video games: https://thedoteaters.com

 -- Gameplay recorded live on Justin.tv, before that service became Twitch.

Facebook 🕹️ https://www.facebook.com/thedoteaters
Twitter 🕹️  https://twitter.com/doteaters
YouTube 🕹️ https://www.youtube.com/user/Umma6umma
Pinterest 🕹️ https://www.pinterest.com/thedoteaters/
